title: Add planner and critic prompts, schemas and briefs (job 2)
summary: Implements job 2 of the job-planning design as pure, unused functions in athena-context. It adds the planner and critic prompts, their strict output schemas, and the planner, critic and plan-section briefs. It also gives verifier_brief an optional plan input that shows only demonstrations and planned files. Audience: the maintainer and the verifier checking the cargo tests.

defaults_applied.how: Tests cover each new function and schema; clippy and fmt are required.
Criteria assert the contents and absences of rendered briefs and schema rejections, not that items exist.
The verifier runs cargo test, clippy and fmt.
One change confined to athena-context plus CHANGELOG.
The F5 restriction (no approach or reasons in the verifier brief) is enforced by absence tests.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Plan record types (JobPlan, PlanDecision, PlanFile, PlanRisk, Demonstration) from job 1 live in crates/athena-data/src/records.rs and are reused rather than redefined.
Output schemas are generated from typed structs, as the existing outputs are, with unknown fields denied at every level.
The 'stored copy of today's output' is a fixture or inline string in a briefs.rs test, captured before the change.
Existing verifier_brief callers get a None plan input. cap-change or cap-study change only if the signature requires it.
budgets.rs changes only if the new frames need budget entries.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run cargo test: planner_brief numbers every criterion with its kind, marks a listed athena.toml (and defaults.toml) as a governance file, and lists the commands the verifier may run. A revision brief contains the previous plan and the text of each finding.
Run cargo test: critic_brief contains every demonstration and each Athena finding. Assertions on absence show it has no planner cost and no planner command list.

Run cargo test: the planner and critic output schemas each reject an extra property at the top level and inside a nested item (additionalProperties false at every level). The critic verdict accepts exactly accept, revise and reject.

Run cargo test: render_plan_section returns identical bytes for the same record called twice, under the heading 'Job plan (accepted, round r)'. verifier_brief with a plan contains the demonstrations and the planned file list but not the plan's approach, decision reasons or rejected options. With no plan its output equals a stored copy of today's output byte for byte.

Run cargo test (including crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs), cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo fmt --check. xtask's boundary test is among the tests. All pass with no change to existing behavior.
prompts/planner.md and prompts/critic.md exist, are short, and are registered in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs as PromptAssets (id, version, include_str!) like the existing frames.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for this change. Nothing calls the planner or critic, and run.rs, status display and athena.toml are unchanged.

departures: The change is larger than the typical job, with three source files and byte-identical regression constraints, so cost and time are higher and the pass probability is lower.
